science_biology.label: Science / Biology
science_biology.notes: Diagrams (cell structures, anatomy, life cycles) must come from extracted source figures, not generated art, once past g3_5.

chemistry.label: Chemistry
chemistry.notes: Molecular structures and reaction equations need accurate rendering; do not let image-gen invent structures.

physics.label: Physics
physics.notes: Vector/force diagrams often need precise extracted figures; generic illustrative diagrams can be generated.

math.label: Mathematics
math.notes: Graphs/plots may be generated programmatically (e.g. matplotlib) rather than via image-gen or extraction.

history_social_studies.label: History / Social Studies
history_social_studies.notes: Maps and primary-source images must be extracted/accurate; portrait illustrations can be generated for younger bands.

language_arts.label: Language Arts / Literature
language_arts.notes: Mostly text-driven; low reliance on diagrams.

computer_science_k12.label: Computer Science (K-12 intro)
computer_science_k12.notes: Keep code examples short and large-font for readability at K-12 density levels.

general_default.label: General / Unspecified Subject
general_default.notes: Fallback when subject tagging is unavailable — use only core archetypes.
